workspace_meta.summary: Self-contained Figma Design review and engineering handoff baseline with separated contract policy, owned public source, and private runtime outputs.
workspace_meta.routes_heading: Directed Click Routes from Current State

nodes.title: Single-collapsible disclosure capture contract
nodes.detail: Defines internal DOM and traversal rules only: one visible accordion root, unique trigger labels, and 3-state 6-direction reachability without external template names or copied text.

nodes.title: Token & Typography Handoff Gate
nodes.detail: All surface, ink, and stroke tokens bind to repo-owned sRGB CSS custom properties using local Inter metrics, uniform 4-sided borders, and zero external font or media requests.
handoff_checks: Body text maintains >= 7:1 contrast and interactive trigger borders maintain >= 3:1 contrast on light surfaces.
Zero external stylesheet, webfont, image, or runtime network fetches occur during browser capture or Figma import.

nodes.title: Single-Collapsible Transition Parity
nodes.detail: All 6 directed trigger actions (2 open, 2 close, and 2 sibling switches) settle deterministically inside a fixed 1440x900 viewport with matching vector chevron orientation.
handoff_checks: Expanding either requirement auto-closes its sibling and keeps collapsed answer text hidden from layout and capture.
Closing an expanded requirement returns to the exact initial All closed state geometry and content hash without scroll drift.

nodes.title: Design Handoff Readiness Review
nodes.detail: Repo-owned 1440x900 desktop review workspace rendering disclosure gates, active state transitions, and three-layer provenance directly from graph.json and manifest.json.

nodes.title: All closed
nodes.detail: Initial baseline state with both production handoff requirement panels collapsed and ready for open traversal.

nodes.title: Token & Typography Handoff Gate expanded
nodes.detail: Token and typography gate criteria expanded for design-to-engineering signoff while transition parity stays collapsed.

nodes.title: Single-Collapsible Transition Parity expanded
nodes.detail: Transition parity criteria expanded for prototype hotspot verification while token gate stays collapsed.

nodes.title: Open Token & Typography Handoff Gate
nodes.detail: Click Token & Typography Handoff Gate from All closed to inspect surface, stroke, and font handoff rules.

nodes.title: Close Token & Typography Handoff Gate
nodes.detail: Click Token & Typography Handoff Gate while expanded to return to All closed.

nodes.title: Switch from Token Gate to Transition Parity
nodes.detail: Click Single-Collapsible Transition Parity while Token Gate is open to auto-close sibling panel and switch states.

nodes.title: Close Single-Collapsible Transition Parity
nodes.detail: Click Single-Collapsible Transition Parity while expanded to return to All closed.

nodes.title: Open Single-Collapsible Transition Parity
nodes.detail: Click Single-Collapsible Transition Parity from All closed to inspect 6-direction prototype routing rules.

nodes.title: Switch from Transition Parity to Token Gate
nodes.detail: Click Token & Typography Handoff Gate while Transition Parity is open to auto-close sibling panel and switch states.

nodes.title: Graph-driven disclosure and state relationship renderer
nodes.detail: Renders disclosures, state transitions, and provenance badges from graph.json and manifest.json with zero duplicated semantic IDs or copy.

nodes.title: Public owned baseline separates policy, source, and private captures across 3 states and 6 routes
nodes.detail: Requires zero external templates or network assets, preserves MIT provenance, and compiles 3 reachable disclosure states with 6 directed transitions.

nodes.title: Strict-local graph, SSOT renderer, and provenance manifest verification
nodes.detail: Checks graph.py strict-local validation, review_graph projection bounds, manifest license integrity, and zero hardcoded semantic copy in HTML/CSS/JS.

nodes.title: Private generated Figma Design frames and ON_CLICK hotspots
nodes.detail: Generated outside Git via tools/web_disclosure_capture.mjs and tools/native_edit.py web-design inside private evidence storage.
